lucee.notes: With Lucee 6 this function now returns the new path

name: DirectoryRename
syntax: DirectoryRename( string oldPath, string newPath, [boolean createPath] )

params.name: oldPath
params.description: Absolute path of the directory to be renamed

params.name: createPath
params.description: if set to false, expects all parent directories to exist, true (default) will generate necessary directories
